name: 01-dark-project-field
title: 선택 전: 오른쪽 공간 전체가 실제 모듈
description: 프리뷰는 왼쪽에 고정합니다. 오른쪽 뒤편에는 기능별로 모인 프로젝트 모듈이 깊이를 따라 놓입니다. 가까운 모듈에는 역할과 작은 내용이 보이고, 먼 모듈은 묶음으로 줄여 표시합니다.
scene: STATE 1, BEFORE SELECTION. The background module field is the visual hero, occupying the right 60% of the window and visibly reaching far into depth. Persistent warm-white cart behavior preview occupies left 36%, with a compact work strip beneath it labeled 'Codex CLI | API Agent'. In the field, several hundred restrained thumbnail module tiles form coherent receding neighborhoods 'Checkout', 'Catalog', 'Orders', 'Accounts', 'Shared' and 'Assets'. These are shallow staggered three-dimensional strata, not an aerial city or standard flat graph. The nearest readable modules include ApplyCoupon with a tiny code fragment, CartState with a value, TotalsView as a miniature UI, Button as an actual little button, a font as one small 'Aa' swatch and a product image thumbnail. They visibly belong to the project, not decorative particles. A slim hierarchy at far right lists those same semantic neighborhoods with collapsed children. The center foreground remains spacious, ready for an assembly to arrive. Cursor hovers over the preview 'Apply' button; a restrained outline identifies the selected visible UI element without yet opening a large feature panel. Top toolbar: 'DEPTH AI', 'Project', 'Explore', 'Changes', search. Bottom status: 'Indexed source' and 'Personal view'. Mood: cinematic depth and quiet precision, high-end development tool. No giant explanatory headline or diagram arrows over the screen.

name: 02-dark-modules-in-flight
title: 선택 순간: 관련 모듈이 원래 자리에서 앞으로
description: 쿠폰 버튼을 고르면 계산·상태·화면·검증 모듈이 각자의 위치에서 앞으로 모입니다. 원래 자리에는 희미한 기준점이 남아 전체 프로젝트와의 관계를 잃지 않습니다.
scene: STATE 2, A SINGLE FROZEN MOMENT IN THE GATHER ANIMATION. Keep exactly the same workspace, cart preview on the left and real module neighborhoods deep to the right. The user has clicked the preview Apply button, outlined sage. Show FIVE identifiable module tiles flying FROM distinct locations in the RIGHT/BACK real project collection TOWARD a shallow large translucent foreground container beside the preview titled 'Apply coupon'. One tile is still deep, two are midway at different depths, two have settled into readable slots. Delicate short sage or champagne motion trails and dim origin silhouettes make direction unambiguous. The moving bodies can turn slightly while their destination faces become front-facing. Show origins in Checkout, Shared and UI neighborhoods rather than inventing five duplicate implementations. Most unrelated background modules remain quietly in their original positions. The feature container is an intelligible staged assembly with labeled areas 'Input', 'Rules', 'State', 'Result', not a random grid. Selected nearby module names are 'Coupon input', 'ApplyCoupon', 'CartState', 'ValidateCoupon', 'TotalsView'. Thin localized connection ports appear only inside this selected assembly, no screen-wide spaghetti. A minimal caption inside the container says '5 related modules · source links'. CLI/API work strip remains below the left preview. Keep the background rich in tangible tiny module records and the foreground sharp, no blurred action-film effects.

name: 03-dark-assembled-editing
title: 도착 후: 기능을 이루는 모듈과 값을 함께 편집
description: 모인 모듈 안에서 역할·연결·속성을 읽고 바꿉니다. 할인율 20%를 25%로 바꾼 예시에서 합계는 $96에서 $90으로 바뀝니다. 공용 모듈은 복제하지 않고 같은 구현을 참조합니다.
scene: STATE 3, SETTLED FOREGROUND FEATURE ASSEMBLY WITH DIRECT EDITING. Persistent shopping cart preview left 36%, selected Apply button. The right center has a big thin smoked-glass feature shell titled 'Apply coupon', with shallow layered thickness slightly angled but all active content front-facing. Within this one feature, readable role-specific constituent modules make a connected composition: compact Coupon input, a prominent central ApplyCoupon code/rule surface, CartState showing subtotal, a slender ValidateCoupon rule and TotalsView showing output. Not six identical generic node boxes; sizes and content reflect role, some nested within a feature layer. In ApplyCoupon show an inline editable property 'Discount %' changing '20' to '25'; code excerpt 'total = subtotal * (1 - rate / 100)'. A subtle local connection indicates cart state enters the rule and the rule updates the totals. Preview 'Subtotal $120.00', 'Discount 25%', 'Total $90.00'; a small before-after chip '$96.00 → $90.00' and state label 'Draft'. A small shared-link mark on CartState says 'Used by Cart + Checkout'; its deep source anchor remains faintly visible in Shared neighborhood. Only one meaningful AI note: 'One pricing rule is shared by cart and checkout.' Source anchor on rule 'src/cart/coupon.ts'. Buttons 'View source', 'Review change'. The real module field and right-side hierarchy remain behind, with unrelated modules dimmed, never hidden completely. No runtime-success claims: use 'Source linked' and 'Preview model'.

name: 04-dark-api-agent
title: API 키 모드: 채팅도 같은 모듈과 코드로 작업
description: API 채팅은 질문만 받는 도움말이 아닙니다. 모듈 검색과 소스 확인, 변경안 작성, 검증 과정을 작업 화면 안에서 보여줍니다. 선택한 기능과 프리뷰도 계속 보입니다.
scene: A FIRST-CLASS API-KEY AGENT DEVELOPMENT WORK SCREEN. Same dark spatial product, real background module field receding along right and above the assembled Apply coupon feature. Persistent cart behavior preview stays upper left, occupying about 35% width and 45% height. Beneath the preview, a substantial beautifully legible agent dock occupies left bottom, not a tiny decorative chat bubble. Its mode switch is 'Codex CLI | API Agent' with 'API Agent' active. Header 'Agent', provider/model selector, status 'API key connected' with only a key icon, no actual secret. User message: 'Make the coupon discount 25%.' Assistant work is grounded in visible project context: small context chip 'Apply coupon · 5 modules'; tool activity rows 'modules.search', 'source.read', 'changes.propose'; then a concise proposal 'Use the shared pricing rule. 1 file affected.' A source path link 'src/cart/coupon.ts', compact before/after property '20 → 25', and status 'Awaiting review'. Clear 'Review change' action. Bottom real message input 'Ask about this project…', attach-context button and send arrow. On the right, the foreground feature shows the SAME selected ApplyCoupon rule and a small source diff, with affected connections highlighted; the background shared-module anchor glows subtly. Chat, code and preview face the viewer, all legible, while the module shell and background are spatial. No made-up CLI replacement and no ordinary customer-support chatbot.

name: 05-light-project-field
title: 라이트 모드: 상아색 공간 속 모듈 전체 보기
description: 다크 모드와 구조는 같습니다. 상아색·연한 돌색·세이지로 공간을 밝히고, 기울어진 배경과 정면 프리뷰를 분리해 깊이와 조작성을 함께 유지합니다.
scene: LIGHT THEME STATE 1, BEFORE SELECTION, MATCHING DARK SCREEN 1 IN CONTENT AND CAMERA. Preserve a warm-white cart behavior preview at left 36%, compact CLI/API work strip beneath it, and a large right 60% real project module field extending into depth. Modules are actual records in Checkout, Catalog, Orders, Accounts, Shared, Assets neighborhoods. Many small frosted ivory physical plates, meaningful thumbnail content in nearer tiles, summarized stacks far away. Near examples include code-bearing ApplyCoupon, CartState, tiny Button swatch and product photo. A slim far-right semantic project hierarchy and search remains visible. The central foreground is calm and unoccupied until selection. Cursor on the preview Apply button with a muted sage outline. Use elegant warm porcelain, stone glass, graphite and sage with subtle champagne edges, never bright blue. Shallow skewed planes and translucent stacked containers follow the original light reference's depth language, but no game-shop content and no unreadable tilted UI. All critical text and preview pixels are front-facing. The light mode must feel like the exact same serious development tool as the dark mode, not a totally different design.

name: 06-light-assembled-agent
title: 라이트 모드: 모듈 조립과 API 채팅을 한 화면에
description: 선택한 기능은 앞으로 나온 반투명 묶음이 됩니다. 채팅·프리뷰·값 입력·코드는 정면으로 두고, 모듈 몸체와 뒤쪽 공간에만 사선과 깊이를 줍니다.
scene: LIGHT THEME SETTLED FEATURE + API AGENT WORKSPACE, matching dark screens 3 and 4. Persistent cart preview upper left, substantial readable API Agent chat lower left with 'Codex CLI | API Agent' mode switch, message 'Make the coupon discount 25%.', tool rows 'modules.search', 'source.read', status 'Proposal ready', message composer. Center-right foreground: one shallow layered frosted-ivory feature container titled 'Apply coupon', skewed body and glass thickness but flat readable faces. Constituents have different semantic forms: input widget, central ApplyCoupon code/rule with editable 'Discount % 25', CartState value surface, a compact validation rule, TotalsView output. Only a few purposeful ports connect input → rule → result within the selection. Small AI note under the rule 'One pricing rule is shared by cart and checkout.' Preview shows subtotal $120, discount 25%, total $90 and a Draft badge. Behind and right, many genuine miniature project module tiles remain in stable grouped neighborhoods with faint selected-source anchors, plus compact hierarchy. Controls 'View source' and 'Review change'. Use ivory/stone/sage/graphite and subtle champagne; prioritize reading clarity rather than icy-blue glow.

name: 07-dark-existing-cli
title: 기존 CLI 모드: MCP 작업이 공간에 반영되는 모습
description: 기존 Codex CLI를 그대로 사용합니다. MCP로 조회한 모듈과 변경 대상이 Depth AI 공간에서 강조되고, 결과는 같은 변경 검토 흐름으로 이어집니다.
scene: EXISTING CODEX CLI VIA MCP, NOT AN INVENTED DEPTH TERMINAL. Same dark spatial workspace, persistent cart preview upper left and selected feature assembly center-right with the real right-back module field. Beneath the left preview, a native-looking terminal panel explicitly titled 'Codex CLI', with familiar plain monospace on warm-black background. Include 'PS C:\Projects\Store> codex' and an understated connection chip 'Depth AI MCP · connected'. Terminal task is 'Make the coupon discount 25%'. Activity lines show 'modules.search', 'modules.get', 'source.read', then 'Proposal ready: src/cart/coupon.ts'. Do not display fabricated install commands or configuration flags. The workspace mode switch has 'Codex CLI' active and 'API Agent' available. Modules touched by those tool calls glow modestly in sage in the distant field, and the same stable ApplyCoupon module is in the foreground assembly with a code/property delta '20 → 25'. A short project work feed indicates 'Context read', 'Change proposed', 'Review pending'. No autonomous applied-success claim. A slim hierarchy remains on the right. This image should make it obvious that an existing CLI works on the SAME source and module context shown in the 3D interface, while critical controls and preview stay front-facing and usable.

name: 08-dark-source-review-settings
title: 코드·근거·변경 검토, 그리고 연결 설정
description: 모듈을 펼치면 실제 소스 위치, 검증 가능한 설계 요약, 영향 범위와 변경안을 봅니다. CLI/MCP와 API 키 연결 설정을 별도 창으로 제공하며, 키는 가려 표시합니다.
scene: SOURCE AND REVIEW WORKSPACE WITH A SMALL CONNECTION SETTINGS POPOVER. Keep cart preview visible at left showing Before $96 and Draft $90, and real module field quietly visible in the far right depth. The selected ApplyCoupon module has expanded into a large front-facing readable source/review surface beside the preview, within the shallow tilted feature shell. Title 'ApplyCoupon', breadcrumb 'Checkout / Pricing', file anchor 'src/cart/coupon.ts'. Tabs 'Code', 'AI notes', 'Changes'. Show a concise code excerpt with visible diff '- rate: 20' and '+ rate: 25' and code 'total = subtotal * (1 - rate / 100)'. A readable short AI note beside the code: 'Purpose: apply a coupon to cart totals.' 'Design: share one pricing rule between cart and checkout.' 'Evidence: source-linked; runtime not observed.' This is a verified-design-summary concept, not hidden chain-of-thought, and not a user comments thread. Affected modules 'Cart', 'Checkout', 'TotalsView'. Review actions 'Apply change' and 'Cancel'; status 'Validation pending'. On upper far right a compact actual settings popover titled 'AI connection', two options 'Local CLI / MCP' and 'API provider', a masked field 'API key ••••••••', provider dropdown, 'Test connection' button. The settings popover must not cover the main source diff or all of the background modules. No readable secret, fake successful tests or guaranteed runtime evidence. Maintain extremely legible warm-graphite/sage glass design.
